view_definitions.cn_inv_dbt_double:
create view ags.cn_inv_dbt_double as
-- получаем задолженности у которых более одной суммы в одной выгрузке
select
	y.iKey, y.inNum, y.ccc, y.account_num, y.ciaName, y.cn_inv_dbt_upl, y.upl_date, count(y.cn_inv_dbt_upl) dCount
from
	(
		select
			z.iKey, inum.inNum, z.ccc, ci.ciKey, ci.ciCn, cias.ciasKey, a.account_num
			--, os.[name]
			, cia.ciaKey, cia.ciaName, o.[name]
			, d.cn_inv_date_maturity, d.dbt_ttl, d.dbt_overd, d.cn_inv_dbt_upl
			, u.upl_date--, u.upl_name
		from
			(
				select
					i.iKey, count(ci.ciKey) as ccc
				from
					ags.inv i
					join ags.cninv ci on i.iKey = ci.ciInv
				group by
					i.iKey
				--having
				--	count(ci.ciKey) > 1
			) as z
			join ags.cninv ci on z.iKey = ci.ciInv
				join ags.cnInvAccntSmpl cias on ci.ciKey = cias.ciasCnInv
					join ags.accnt a on cias.ciasAccnt = a.account_key
					join ags.cn_s_org_smplCs os on cias.ciasCn_s_org_smpl = os.csosKey
					join ags.cnInvAccnt cia on cias.ciasKey = cia.ciaCnInvAccntSmpl
						join ags.cn_s_orgCs o on cia.ciaCn_s_org = o.cn_s_org_key
						join ags.cn_inv_dbt d on cia.ciaKey = d.cidCnInvAccntCtpt
							join ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl u on d.cn_inv_dbt_upl = u.upl_key
			join ags.invWithNum inum on z.iKey = inum.iKey
		--order by
		--	z.iKey, ci.ciCn, cias.ciasKey, cia.ciaKey, u.upl_date
	) as y
group by
	y.iKey, y.inNum, y.ccc, y.account_num, y.ciaName, y.cn_inv_dbt_upl, y.upl_date
having
	count(y.cn_inv_dbt_upl) <> 1
view_definitions.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl:
/* Платежи относящиеся к Выгрузке бухгалтерии на основании связи между этой выгрузкой и Выгрузкой БУиРГ
 На настоящий момент есть 3367 платежей в расширенных выгрузках и здесь они все прицепились к выгрузкам бухгалтерии
 Как бы здесь понимаем, какие выгрузки бухгалтерии соответствуют каждому платежу из расширенной выгрузки*/
CREATE VIEW ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl
AS
SELECT        pmug.cn_inv_dbt_upl, ipm.cn_inv_pm_upl, ipm.cn_inv_pm_key, ags.cnInvAccnt.ciaCnInv AS cn_inv_key, ipm.cn_s_agent, ipm.cn_inv_doc, ipm.constract_code, ipm.cnipCstAgPn, ipm.cn_inv_pm_due, 
                         ipm.dbt_blns, ipm.dbt_blns_overd, ipm.dbt_blns_not_overd, ipm.cdt_blns, ipm.cdt_blns_overd, ipm.cdt_blns_not_overd, ipm.blns, ipm.alignment_date, ipm.base_date, ipm.storno_reason, ipm.storno_doc, 
                         ipm.number, ipm.mark
FROM            ags.cn_inv_pm_upl AS pmu INNER JOIN
                         ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_g_p AS pmug ON pmu.cn_inv_pm_key = pmug.cn_inv_pm_upl INNER JOIN
                         ags.cn_inv_pm AS ipm ON pmu.cn_inv_pm_key = ipm.cn_inv_pm_upl INNER JOIN
                         ags.cnInvAccnt ON ipm.cipCnInvAccnt = ags.cnInvAccnt.ciaKey
view_definitions.dym_pm_pm:
-- Берем по бухвыгрузке из инвойсов всё, что нужно для таблички ДЮМ, но ID-ы оставляем только для пары бухвыгрузки и инвойса с платежами
create view ags.dym_pm_pm as
SELECT 
	dym.upl_key, 
	dym.upl_date, 
	dym.upl_name, 
	dym.number, 
	dym.debt_type, 
	dym.main_account, 
	dym.org_id_value_l, 
	dym.ogNm, 
	dym.cn_number, 
	dym.cn_date, 
	dym.inv_of_dbt, 
	dym.cn_inv_key as dym_cn_inv_key, 
	dym.cn_inv_date_start, 
	dym.cn_inv_date_maturity, 
	dym.dbt_ttl, 
	dym.dbt_overd, 
	dym_pm.cn_inv_dbt_upl, 
	dym_pm.cn_inv_key
FROM 
	(
		SELECT 
			cn_inv_dbt_upl.upl_key, 
			cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_dbt_upl, 
			cn_inv_dbt_upl.upl_date, 
			cn_inv_dbt_upl.upl_name, 
			cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_key AS inv_of_dbt, 
			cn_inv.cn_inv_key, 
			cn_inv_dbt.number, 
			cn_inv_dbt.debt_type, 
			accnt.account_num AS main_account, 
			org_id.org_id_value_l, 
			og.ogNm, 
			cn.cn_number, 
			cn.cn_date, 
			cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_date_start, 
			cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_date_maturity, 
			cn_inv_dbt.dbt_ttl, 
			cn_inv_dbt.dbt_overd
		FROM 
			ags.og 
			INNER JOIN 
				(
					ags.org_id 
					INNER JOIN 
						(
							ags.cn 
							INNER JOIN 
								(
									ags.cn_s 
									INNER JOIN 
										(
											ags.cn_s_org 
											INNER JOIN 
												(
													(
														ags.accnt 
														INNER JOIN 
															ags.cn_inv 
															ON accnt.account_key = cn_inv.accnt
													) 
													INNER JOIN 
														(
															ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl 
															INNER JOIN 
																ags.cn_inv_dbt 
																ON cn_inv_dbt_upl.upl_key = cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_dbt_upl
														) 
														ON cn_inv.cn_inv_key = cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_key
												) 
												ON cn_s_org.cn_s_org_key = cn_inv.cn_s_kontr
										) 
										ON cn_s.cn_s_key = cn_s_org.cn_s_key
								) 
								ON cn.cn_key = cn_s.cn_key
						) 
						ON org_id.org_id_key = cn_s_org.org_id
				) 
				ON og.ogKey = org_id.org
	) as dym
	-- Здесь ВСЕ задолженности (идентифицированные по счёт-фактуре) с которыми имеем дело. Сейчас их 4047
	LEFT JOIN 
		(
			SELECT 
				cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl.cn_inv_dbt_upl, 
				cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl.cn_inv_key, 
				Count(cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl.cn_inv_pm_key) AS [Count-cn_inv_pm_key]
			FROM 
				(
					SELECT 
						pmug.cn_inv_dbt_upl, 
						ipm.cn_inv_pm_upl, 
						ipm.cn_inv_pm_key, 
						ipm.cn_inv_key, 
						ipm.cn_s_agent, 
						ipm.cn_inv_doc, 
						ipm.constract_code, 
						ipm.cn_inv_pm_due, 
						ipm.dbt_blns, 
						ipm.dbt_blns_overd, 
						ipm.dbt_blns_not_overd, 
						ipm.cdt_blns, 
						ipm.cdt_blns_overd, 
						ipm.cdt_blns_not_overd, 
						ipm.blns, 
						ipm.alignment_date, 
						ipm.base_date, 
						ipm.storno_reason, 
						ipm.storno_doc
					FROM 
						ags.cn_inv_pm_upl pmu
						INNER JOIN 
							ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_g_p pmug
							ON pmu.cn_inv_pm_key = pmug.cn_inv_pm_upl 
							INNER JOIN 
								ags.cn_inv_pm ipm
								ON pmu.cn_inv_pm_key = ipm.cn_inv_pm_upl
				) as cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl
			GROUP BY 
				cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl.cn_inv_dbt_upl, 
				cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl.cn_inv_key
		) as dym_pm 
		ON 
			(dym.cn_inv_key = dym_pm.cn_inv_key) 
			AND 
			(dym.cn_inv_dbt_upl = dym_pm.cn_inv_dbt_upl)
			--where dym_pm.cn_inv_dbt_upl is not null;
view_definitions.q_cn_inv_dbt_upl_sum:
CREATE view [ags].[q_cn_inv_dbt_upl_sum] as
select
	a.account_num, u.upl_key, u.upl_date, u.upl_name, u.uplNmCs, sum(d.dbt_ttl) ttl, sum(d.dbt_overd) overd
from
	ags.cn_inv_dbt d
	join
		ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl u
		on d.cn_inv_dbt_upl = u.upl_key
	join
		ags.cnInvAccnt i
		on d.cidCnInvAccntCtpt = i.ciaKey
		join
			ags.cnInvAccntSmpl s
			on i.ciaCnInvAccntSmpl = s.ciasKey
			join
				ags.accnt a
				on s.ciasAccnt = a.account_key
group by rollup
	(a.account_num), u.upl_key, u.upl_date, u.upl_name, u.uplNmCs
view_definitions.q_cn_inv_pm_upl_sum:
create view ags.q_cn_inv_pm_upl_sum
as
select
	p.cn_inv_pm_upl, a.account_num, 
	sum(p.dbt_blns) as dbt_blns, sum(p.dbt_blns_overd) as dbt_blns_overd, sum(p.dbt_blns_not_overd) as dbt_blns_not_overd, 
	sum(p.cdt_blns) as cdt_blns, sum(p.cdt_blns_overd) as cdt_blns_overd, sum(p.cdt_blns_not_overd) as cdt_blns_not_overd, 
	sum(p.blns) as blns
from
	ags.cn_inv_pm p
	join
		ags.cnInvAccntSmpl s
		on p.ciaCnInvAccntSmpl = s.ciasKey
		join
			ags.accnt a
			on s.ciasAccnt = a.account_key
group by rollup
	(p.cn_inv_pm_upl, a.account_num)
view_definitions.ralp:

view_definitions.yr_ctrl:
create view ags.yr_ctrl as
select 
	x.yr_key,
	x.cn_inv_dbt_upl as upl_prnt,
	x.cn_inv_key,
	xx.cn_inv_dbt_upl as upl_chld,
	convert(nvarchar, xx.upl_date) + '_ttl' as upl_date_ttl,
	convert(nvarchar, xx.upl_date) + '_ovr' as upl_date_ovr,
	xx.dbt_ttl,
	xx.dbt_overd
from
(
	SELECT        
		ags.yr.yr_key, 
		ags.cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_dbt_upl, 
		ags.cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_key
	FROM 
		ags.cn_inv_dbt -- пара бухвыгрузка+счёт-фактура
		INNER JOIN
			ags.yr -- вариант года
			ON ags.cn_inv_dbt.cn_inv_dbt_upl = ags.yr.cn_inv_dbt_upl
) as x -- здесь выбираем все пары "бухвыгрузка+счёт-фактура" для бухвыгрузки определенной как контрольная для варианта года
	left join
		(
			SELECT        
				u.upl_date,
				y.yr_key, 
				d.cn_inv_dbt_upl, 
				d.cn_inv_key, 
				d.dbt_ttl, 
				d.dbt_overd
			FROM            
				ags.cn_inv_dbt AS d -- пара бухвыгрузка+счёт-фактура
				INNER JOIN
                    ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl AS u -- бухвыгрузка
					ON d.cn_inv_dbt_upl = u.upl_key 
						INNER JOIN
                         ags.yr_upl_p AS p -- привязка бухвыгрузки к варианту года
						 ON u.upl_key = p.cn_inv_dbt_upl 
							INNER JOIN
							ags.yr AS y -- вариант года
								ON p.yr_upl_p_yr = y.yr_key
		) as xx -- здесь выбираем все пары "бухвыгрузка+счёт-фактура" для всех бухвыгрузок относящихся к варианту года
		on
			x.yr_key = xx.yr_key and x.cn_inv_key = xx.cn_inv_key
--WHERE        
--	(x.yr_key = 1)
view_definitions.yr_ctrl_cm:
/****** Скрипт для команды SelectTopNRows из среды SSMS  ******/
CREATE view ags.yr_ctrl_cm as
select
	dbt.number
	, dbt.debt_type
	, acc.account_num
	, isnull(agn.AgName, 'нет в выгрузке БУиРГ') as AgName
	, cmm.order_214
	, oi.org_id_value_l as kontraNum
	, o.ogNm
	, cn.cn_number
	, cn.cn_date
	, inv.cn_inv_num
	, do.dOccur -- дата образования, беру по самому раннему документу из выгрузки платежей
	, dbt.cn_inv_date_maturity -- дата погашения
	, x.yr_key
	, x.upl_prnt
	, x.cn_inv_key
	, x.upl_chld
	, x.bs_ttl
	, x.bs_ovr
	, cmm.overd_agent
	, x1.qu_I_upl_chld
	, x1.qu_I_ttl
	, x1.qu_I_ovr
	, iif
		(
			isnull(x.bs_ovr, 0) <> 0 and x.bs_ovr > isnull(x1.qu_I_ovr, 0),
			x.bs_ovr - isnull(x1.qu_I_ovr, 0), 
			null
		) as qu_I_matured
	, x2.qu_II_upl_chld
	, x2.qu_II_ttl
	, x2.qu_II_ovr
	, iif
		(
			isnull(x.bs_ovr, 0) <> 0 and x.bs_ovr > isnull(x2.qu_II_ovr, 0),
			x.bs_ovr - isnull(x2.qu_II_ovr, 0), 
			null
		) as qu_II_matured
	, x3.qu_III_upl_chld
	, x3.qu_III_ttl
	, x3.qu_III_ovr
	, iif
		(
			isnull(x.bs_ovr, 0) <> 0 and x.bs_ovr > isnull(x3.qu_III_ovr, 0),
			x.bs_ovr - isnull(x3.qu_III_ovr, 0), 
			null
		) as qu_III_matured
	, x4.qu_IV_upl_chld
	, x4.qu_IV_ttl
	, x4.qu_IV_ovr
	, iif
		(
			isnull(x.bs_ovr, 0) <> 0 and x.bs_ovr > isnull(x4.qu_IV_ovr, 0),
			x.bs_ovr - isnull(x4.qu_IV_ovr, 0), 
			null
		) as qu_IV_matured
	, x5.qu_V_upl_chld
	, x5.qu_V_ttl
	, x5.qu_V_ovr
	, iif
		(
			isnull(x.bs_ovr, 0) <> 0 and x.bs_ovr > isnull(x5.qu_V_ovr, 0),
			x.bs_ovr - isnull(x5.qu_V_ovr, 0), 
			null
		) as qu_V_matured
	, cmm.progn_matur
	, cmm.cstCode cstCodeCm
	, cmm.cstName cstNameCm
	, cmm.codeFind
	, cmm.codeFind2
	, isnull(cnstCd.constCode, 'нет в выгрузке БУиРГ') as cstCodeUpl
	, cst.cstName as cstNameUpl
	, cmm.toMaturAction
	, cmm.note
	, cmm.note_kur
	, cmm.work_overd
	, cmm.toGI
	, cmm.errBUiRG
	, cmm.noLimits
	, cmm.process
	, cmm.terminationContr
	, cmm.manager
from
	(
		SELECT 
			[yr_key]
			,[upl_prnt]
			,[cn_inv_key]
			,[upl_chld]
			,[dbt_ttl] as bs_ttl
			,[dbt_overd] as bs_ovr
		FROM 
			ags.yr_ctrl y
		where
			y.yr_key = 1 and y.upl_prnt = y.upl_chld
	) as x -- базовая табличка из запроса контроля
	left join
		(
			SELECT 
				[yr_key]
				,[upl_prnt]
				,[cn_inv_key]
				,[upl_chld] as qu_I_upl_chld
				,[dbt_ttl] as qu_I_ttl
				,[dbt_overd] as qu_I_ovr
			FROM 
				ags.yr_ctrl y
			where
				y.upl_chld = 5
		) as x1
		on x.yr_key = x1.yr_key and x.upl_prnt = x1.upl_prnt and x.cn_inv_key = x1.cn_inv_key
	left join
		(
			SELECT 
				[yr_key]
				,[upl_prnt]
				,[cn_inv_key]
				,[upl_chld] as qu_II_upl_chld
				,[dbt_ttl] as qu_II_ttl
				,[dbt_overd] as qu_II_ovr
			FROM 
				ags.yr_ctrl y
			where
				y.upl_chld = 3
		) as x2
		on x.yr_key = x2.yr_key and x.upl_prnt = x2.upl_prnt and x.cn_inv_key = x2.cn_inv_key
	left join
		(
			SELECT 
				[yr_key]
				,[upl_prnt]
				,[cn_inv_key]
				,[upl_chld] as qu_III_upl_chld
				,[dbt_ttl] as qu_III_ttl
				,[dbt_overd] as qu_III_ovr
			FROM 
				ags.yr_ctrl y
			where
				y.upl_chld = 2
		) as x3
		on x.yr_key = x3.yr_key and x.upl_prnt = x3.upl_prnt and x.cn_inv_key = x3.cn_inv_key
	left join
		(
			SELECT 
				[yr_key]
				,[upl_prnt]
				,[cn_inv_key]
				,[upl_chld] as qu_IV_upl_chld
				,[dbt_ttl] as qu_IV_ttl
				,[dbt_overd] as qu_IV_ovr
			FROM 
				ags.yr_ctrl y
			where
				y.upl_chld = 6
		) as x4
		on x.yr_key = x4.yr_key and x.upl_prnt = x4.upl_prnt and x.cn_inv_key = x4.cn_inv_key
	left join
		(
			SELECT 
				[yr_key]
				,[upl_prnt]
				,[cn_inv_key]
				,[upl_chld] as qu_V_upl_chld
				,[dbt_ttl] as qu_V_ttl
				,[dbt_overd] as qu_V_ovr
			FROM 
				ags.yr_ctrl y
			where
				y.upl_chld = 0
		) as x5
		on x.yr_key = x5.yr_key and x.upl_prnt = x5.upl_prnt and x.cn_inv_key = x5.cn_inv_key
	left join
		ags.cn_inv_dbt dbt -- таблица пар бухвыгрузка+счёт-фактура, задолженностей
		on x.cn_inv_key = dbt.cn_inv_key and x.upl_prnt = dbt.cn_inv_dbt_upl
	left join
		ags.cn_inv inv -- таблица счётов-фактур
		on x.cn_inv_key = inv.cn_inv_key
		left join
			ags.accnt acc -- таблица счетов
			on inv.accnt = acc.account_key
		left join
			ags.cn_s_org cso -- таблица стороны договора с организацией
			on inv.cn_s_kontr = cso.cn_s_org_key
			left join
				ags.org_id oi -- таблица идентификаторов организаций
				on cso.org_id = oi.org_id_key
				left join
				ags.og o -- таблица организаций
					on oi.org = o.ogKey
			left join
				ags.cn_s cns -- таблица сторон договоров
				on cso.cn_s_key = cns.cn_s_key
				left join
					ags.cn cn
					on cns.cn_key = cn.cn_key
	left join
		(
			select
				c1c.cn_inv_dbt_upl
				, c1c.cn_inv_key
				, iif
					(
						c1c.constCodeCount = 1,
						convert(nvarchar, c2.constract_code),
						iif
							(
								c1c.constCodeCount = 0,
								'код не определен',
								'количество кодов -' + convert(nvarchar, c1c.constCodeCount)
							)
					) as constCode --nvarchar
			from
				(
					select 
						cc.cn_inv_dbt_upl
						, cc.cn_inv_key
						, count(cc.constract_code) as constCodeCount
					from
						(
							select 
								u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
								, u.cn_inv_key
								, u.constract_code
							from 
								ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl u
							group by
								u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
								, u.cn_inv_key
								, u.constract_code
						) as cc
					group by 
						cc.cn_inv_dbt_upl
						, cc.cn_inv_key
				) as c1c
				left join
					(
						select
							c1.cn_inv_dbt_upl
							, c1.cn_inv_key
							, c1.constCodeCount
							, ccc.constract_code
						from
							(
								select 
									cc.cn_inv_dbt_upl
									, cc.cn_inv_key
									, count(cc.constract_code) as constCodeCount
								from
									(
										select 
											u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
											, u.cn_inv_key
											, u.constract_code
										from 
											ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl u
										group by
											u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
											, u.cn_inv_key
											, u.constract_code
									) as cc
								group by 
									cc.cn_inv_dbt_upl
									, cc.cn_inv_key
							) as c1
							inner join
							(
								select 
									u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
									, u.cn_inv_key
									, u.constract_code
								from 
									ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl u
								group by
									u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
									, u.cn_inv_key
									, u.constract_code
							) as ccc
							on c1.cn_inv_dbt_upl = ccc.cn_inv_dbt_upl and c1.cn_inv_key = ccc.cn_inv_key
						where c1.constCodeCount = 1
					) as c2
					on c1c.cn_inv_dbt_upl = c2.cn_inv_dbt_upl and c1c.cn_inv_key = c2.cn_inv_key
		) as cnstCd
		on x3.qu_III_upl_chld = cnstCd.cn_inv_dbt_upl and x.cn_inv_key = cnstCd.cn_inv_key
	left join
		ags.cstAgPn cap
		on cnstCd.constCode = cap.cstapIpgPnN
			left join
			ags.cstAg ca
			on cap.cstapCsta = ca.cstaKey
				left join
					ags.cst cst
					on ca.cstaCst = cst.cstKey
	left join
		(
			select
				ag.cn_inv_dbt_upl, ag.cn_inv_key
				, iif
					(
						isnull(ag_1.ogNm,'*') = '*',
						'количество агентов - ' + convert(nvarchar, ag.ogKeyCount),
						ag_1.ogNm
					) as AgName
			from
				(
					select 
						onm.cn_inv_dbt_upl, onm.cn_inv_key, count(onm.ogKey) as ogKeyCount
					from
						(
							select 
								u.cn_inv_dbt_upl, u.cn_inv_key, o.ogKey
							from 
								ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl u
								join
									ags.cn_s_org cso
									on u.cn_s_agent = cso.cn_s_org_key
									join
										ags.org_id oi
										on cso.org_id = oi.org_id_key
											join
												ags.og o
												on oi.org = o.ogKey
							group by
								u.cn_inv_dbt_upl, u.cn_inv_key, o.ogKey
						) as onm
					group by
						onm.cn_inv_dbt_upl, onm.cn_inv_key
				) as ag
				left join
					(
							select 
								onc.cn_inv_dbt_upl, onc.cn_inv_key, oo.ogNm
							from
								(
									select 
										onm.cn_inv_dbt_upl, onm.cn_inv_key, count(onm.ogNm) as ogNmCount
									from
										(
											select 
												u.cn_inv_dbt_upl, u.cn_inv_key, o.ogNm
											from 
												ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl u
												join
													ags.cn_s_org cso
													on u.cn_s_agent = cso.cn_s_org_key
													join
														ags.org_id oi
														on cso.org_id = oi.org_id_key
															join
																ags.og o
																on oi.org = o.ogKey
											group by
												u.cn_inv_dbt_upl, u.cn_inv_key, o.ogNm
										) as onm
									group by
										onm.cn_inv_dbt_upl, onm.cn_inv_key
								) as onc
								join
									ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl uu
									on onc.cn_inv_dbt_upl = uu.cn_inv_dbt_upl and onc.cn_inv_key = uu.cn_inv_key
										join
											ags.cn_s_org csoo
											on uu.cn_s_agent = csoo.cn_s_org_key
											join
												ags.org_id oii
												on csoo.org_id = oii.org_id_key
													join
														ags.og oo
														on oii.org = oo.ogKey
							group by
								onc.cn_inv_dbt_upl, onc.cn_inv_key, oo.ogNm, onc.ogNmCount
							having onc.ogNmCount = 1
					) as ag_1
					on ag.cn_inv_dbt_upl = ag_1.cn_inv_dbt_upl and ag.cn_inv_key = ag_1.cn_inv_key
		) as agn
		on x3.qu_III_upl_chld = agn.cn_inv_dbt_upl and x.cn_inv_key = agn.cn_inv_key
	left join
		(
			select
				u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
				, u.cn_inv_key
				, min(d.cn_inv_doc_date) as dOccur
			from
				ags.cn_inv_dbt_upl_pm_upl u
				join
					ags.cn_inv_doc d
					on u.cn_inv_doc = d.cn_inv_doc_key
			group by
				u.cn_inv_dbt_upl
				, u.cn_inv_key
		) as do  -- дата образования, беру по самому раннему документу из выгрузки платежей
		on x3.qu_III_upl_chld = do.cn_inv_dbt_upl and x.cn_inv_key = do.cn_inv_key
	left join
		ags.impCmmts cmm -- добавляем комментарии управлений по соответствующей группе
		on x.cn_inv_key = cmm.cn_inv_key_r and cmm.impGr = 1

		) as agn
		on x.upl_chld
			--x3.qu_III_upl_chld

	left join

			from

			group by

				, u.cn_inv_key
